title: Training Notes — Linden Membership and the Good-Faith Percentage, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Rule taught.** The good-faith percentage of a final-notice paydown on the Patient Financial Account is lowered by 10 points for a patient whose membership under Linden Memberships is active and was activated at least 6 calendar months before the handling date, by 5 points for an active membership activated more recently, and by nothing when no membership is active.

The records read are the patient's Linden Memberships record: its status (active or not) and its activation date.

**Counting months.** A window of calendar months for the final-notice paydown ends on the handling date and reaches back that many months, a date on the same calendar day that many months earlier falling outside it. A membership activated on the same calendar day 6 months before the handling date was activated at least 6 months before it.

## Questions from training

**Q. Membership activated 2 February, handling date 2 August.** Exactly 6 calendar months: lowered by 10 points.

**Q. Membership activated 3 February, handling date 2 August.** Fewer than 6 calendar months: lowered by 5 points.

**Q. Membership cancelled last year, none active now.** Lowered by nothing.

| Membership under Linden Memberships | Activated | Lowered by |
|---|---|---|
| active | 6 or more calendar months before the handling date | 10 points |
| active | fewer than 6 calendar months before | 5 points |
| none active | — | nothing |
